title: Claude for Startups: What the Free Year of Claude Team Is Worth
desc: Anthropic's Claude for Startups now gives approved founders a free year of Claude Team, worth $6,000, plus $1,000 in API credits. Who qualifies and the catches.
keywords: claude for startups, claude startups program, anthropic startup credits, free claude team, claude api credits for startups, claude startup program eligibility, claude team pricing, claude startup stack
body:
October 7, 2026. Anthropic expanded its Claude Startups program on October 6. Approved companies get a free year of Claude Team for up to five Premium seats, which Anthropic values at $6,000, plus a one-time $1,000 in Claude API credits that expire six months after they are granted. Startups founded in the last five years or funded in the last two can apply, bootstrapped ones included, according to Anthropic's announcement. Here is what the offer is worth, the fine print that decides it, and what to do once you are in.

What approved startups get

  1. A free year of Claude Team. Up to five Premium seats, for organizations that are new to Team. Claude's pricing page lists Premium seats at $100 per seat a month billed annually or $125 billed monthly, with five times the usage of a Standard seat; Team is sold for teams of 2 to 150.
  2. $1,000 in API credits. A one-time credit for the first-party Claude API through the Claude Console. It cannot be spent on AWS Bedrock or Google Cloud Vertex AI, it expires six months after it is granted, and members who receive credits get higher API rate limits.
  3. The Claude Startup Stack. Discounts and credits from companies building on Claude, worth up to $45,000 at partner list prices as of September 2026. Actual value depends on the offers you redeem.
  4. More credits through partner VCs. Founders backed by a venture firm in Anthropic's partner network can get up to $100,000 in additional API credits, claimed through the firm.
  5. Office hours and distribution. Members can book 45-minute office hours with Anthropic's Applied AI team, get help building and submitting a Claude Marketplace listing, and join events such as Founder House and hackathons.

TechCrunch reported the same terms.

What the credits and seats buy

Anthropic's $6,000 figure is five Premium seats at $100 a month for 12 months, and its headline of up to $7,000 adds the $1,000 credit. At Claude Sonnet 5.5's $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, an agent call that reads 20,000 tokens and writes 1,000 costs $0.05, so $1,000 covers about 20,000 such calls. On Claude Opus 5.5, at $4 and $20, the same call costs $0.10 and the credit covers about 10,000. Spread over the six months before the credit expires, the Sonnet figure is roughly 110 calls a day.

Plan for month 13 now. At list prices, five Premium seats cost $6,000 a year billed annually or $7,500 billed monthly. Five Standard seats, at $20 a seat billed annually or $25 monthly, cost $1,200 or $1,500 a year. Team prices the two seat types separately, so if only one or two people need heavy usage, budget for those on Premium and the rest on Standard.

The fine print that decides it

Only organizations new to Claude Team qualify for the free year, so a team already paying for Team gets the credits but not the seats. Applicants need a Claude Console account, a company email address on the same domain as the company website and a short description of what they are building, and they must meet Anthropic's supportability policies, per the program FAQ. Most applications are decided within minutes; the rest go to manual review, which usually takes two to three business days. Because the credit expires six months after it is granted, claim it when the build starts, not the day you are approved.

What it means for operators

For a founder, the offer covers a year of Claude for up to five people and the first stretch of production traffic. Set a spend limit in the Console before the credit runs out, route routine calls to Sonnet and save Opus for the steps that need it, and decide which seats stay on Premium before renewal. If you want a product on Claude shipped rather than prototyped, our SaaS launch team and AI engineers build on this stack.

The benefit most founders will undervalue is the Marketplace help. An approved listing puts a product in front of people who already use Claude, in Claude's own apps, which is the same audience AI search optimization works to reach when a buyer asks an assistant what to use.
faqs: Who is eligible for Claude for Startups?

Startups founded in the last five years or funded in the last two can apply, including bootstrapped and pre-seed companies. Applicants need a Claude Console account, a company email address that matches the company website's domain and a short description of what they are building, and they must comply with Anthropic's supportability policies.
What is the free year of Claude Team worth?

Anthropic values it at $6,000: one year of Claude Team with five Premium seats at $100 per seat per month, billed annually. With the one-time $1,000 API credit, the stated value is up to $7,000. The free year is only for organizations that are new to Claude Team.
Do Claude for Startups API credits expire?

Yes. The $1,000 credit expires six months after it is granted. It applies to the first-party Claude API through the Claude Console and cannot be used on AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI or other third-party platforms.
What do Claude Team seats cost after the free year?

Claude's pricing page lists Premium seats at $100 per seat per month billed annually or $125 billed monthly, and Standard seats at $20 billed annually or $25 monthly. Five Premium seats cost $6,000 a year on annual billing, while five Standard seats cost $1,200.
